title: aye jaane dile hydere karrar alamdar
body:
Ae jane dile hydere karrar Alamdar Alamdar, Ae quwaate sibte shahe abrar Alamdar Alamdar.
Ta hashr teri yaad zamane me rahegi, Ae sarware alam ke wafadar Alamdar Alamdar.
Marne se tere lashkare sheh hogaya barbad, Ae mere musibat ke madadgar Alamdar Alamdar.
Dikhlado fir ek bar mujhe chand si surat, Marta hai tera talibe deedar Alamdar Alamdar.
Darya se utho bhai ki imdad ko aao, Tanha hai ye ab bekaso nachat Alamdar Alamdar.
Jab tak safe matam meri duniya me bichegi, Royege tujhe mere azadar Alamdar Alamdar.
